_README: Read-only snapshot of the AIAIC facts VANA / Group 3 cites. Copied OUT of the AIAIC repository, which is BHIV reference material and was not modified. VANA has no runtime dependency on the AIAIC path - the two live sources are called directly over HTTP.
_source_repository: AIAIC (Agricultural Intelligence & Income Creation Platform) - READ ONLY

_summary.note: In AIAIC's vocabulary 'verified_live' means the source is REAL AND WIRED. It does NOT mean a live API call - ten of the fourteen are local CSVs or PDF extractions.

sources.source_name: Agmarknet — Variety-wise Daily Market Prices of Commodities (Mandi)
sources.attribution: Source: Directorate of Marketing & Inspection (Agmarknet), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India, via data.gov.in (Government Open Data License – India).

sources.source_name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) & Cost of Production — CACP / Dept. of Agriculture
sources.access_method: data.gov.in REST API (api-key) and CACP/PIB published tables
sources.attribution: Source: Commission for Agricultural Costs & Prices (CACP), Dept. of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India; obtained via data.gov.in (GODL-India; resource published under the Rajya Sabha collection).

sources.access_method: Local CSV downloaded from data.gov.in (Crop/State/MSP/Cost table)
sources.attribution: Source: Commission for Agricultural Costs & Prices (CACP), Dept. of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India; via data.gov.in (GODL-India). Tabled in Rajya Sabha (Session 246, Unstarred Q. AU1158).

sources.access_method: data.gov.in REST API (api-key) and IMD published rainfall statistics
sources.attribution: Source: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India, via data.gov.in (NDSAP / GODL-India).

sources.source_name: Central Ground Water Board — Dynamic Ground Water Resources / assessment categories
sources.access_method: Local CSV (CGWB National Compilation on Dynamic Ground Water Resources, district-level Maharashtra), downloaded by owner from data.opencity.in
sources.license: GODL-India (source: CGWB / Ministry of Jal Shakti; republished via OpenCity)
sources.attribution: Source: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India — National Compilation on Dynamic Ground Water Resources of India; obtained via OpenCity (data.opencity.in).

sources.source_name: Warehousing Development & Regulatory Authority — Registered Warehouses / e-NWR
sources.access_method: WDRA public portal (registered warehouses listing) and published e-NWR statistics
sources.attribution: Source: Warehousing Development & Regulatory Authority (WDRA), Department of Food & Public Distribution, Government of India.

sources.source_name: GSDA Dynamic Ground Water Resources of Maharashtra 2023 — watershed/assessment-unit level
sources.access_method: Extracted from the GSDA+CGWB GWRE-2023 report PDF (Annexure-A-II) to CSV (pdfplumber)
sources.attribution: Source: Groundwater Surveys & Development Agency (GSDA), Govt. of Maharashtra & Central Ground Water Board — Dynamic Ground Water Resources of Maharashtra 2023 (gsda.maharashtra.gov.in).

sources.source_name: GSDA Dynamic GW Resources of Maharashtra 2023 — TALUKA-level categorization (Annexure-E)
sources.access_method: Extracted from the GSDA GWRE-2023 report PDF (Annexure-E) to CSV (pdfplumber)
sources.attribution: Source: GSDA, Govt. of Maharashtra & CGWB — Dynamic Ground Water Resources of Maharashtra 2023, Annexure-E (gsda.maharashtra.gov.in).

sources.source_name: GSDA Ground Water Drought Index (GWDI) — taluka-level, Oct 2024 & Oct 2025
sources.access_method: Extracted from the GSDA GWDI report PDFs to CSV (pdfplumber)
sources.attribution: Source: Groundwater Surveys & Development Agency (GSDA), Govt. of Maharashtra — Ground Water Drought Index reports (gsda.maharashtra.gov.in/en-reports/).

sources.access_method: Open-Meteo REST API (no key; api.open-meteo.com forecast + archive-api.open-meteo.com)
sources.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC-BY 4.0), aggregating national weather services.

sources.source_name: NASA POWER — daily agroclimatology (precipitation, temperature, humidity)
sources.access_method: NASA POWER REST API (no key; power.larc.nasa.gov daily point)
sources.update_frequency: daily, observational (~2-3 day latency) + multi-decade archive
sources.license: NASA POWER — free and open (no restrictions); cite the NASA POWER Project.
sources.attribution: These data were obtained from the NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project (power.larc.nasa.gov).

sources.source_name: eNAM (National Agriculture Market) — public price dashboards
sources.attribution: Source: National Agriculture Market (eNAM), Small Farmers' Agribusiness Consortium, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India.

sources.source_name: Public agricultural advisories (IMD Agromet / ICAR-KVK district advisories)
sources.access_method: Public advisory bulletins (IMD Agromet, KVK), text/PDF
sources.attribution: Source: IMD Agrometeorology Division / ICAR Krishi Vigyan Kendras, Government of India.

sources.source_name: Maharashtra surface-water context — India-WRIS Water-Resource-Projects (command area, dams) + CWC/NWDP river/reservoir/canal gauges
sources.access_method: Local curated CSVs (surface-water-prep/curated/), deterministically derived from the raw India-WRIS / CWC-NWDP haul downloaded by the owner from indiawris.gov.in and the CWC National Water Data Portal (NWDP/NWIC)
sources.update_frequency: as_published (static WRIS command/dam inventory; multi-decade CWC/NWDP gauge series)
sources.license: GODL-India (source: India-WRIS / Central Water Commission, Ministry of Jal Shakti)
sources.attribution: Source: India-WRIS & Central Water Commission (CWC), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India — republished under GODL-India; curated for AIAIC.

sources.source_name: Madhya Pradesh water context — NWDP (National Water Data Portal / NWIC) telemetry: rainfall, reservoir/canal/river discharge, river level, groundwater level, surface-water quality, temperature
sources.access_method: Local curated CSVs (mp-water-prep/curated/), deterministically aggregated from the raw NWDP CKAN datastore haul (nwdp.nwic.gov.in) downloaded by the owner, State-filtered to Madhya Pradesh
sources.update_frequency: as_published (NWDP telemetry 2021-2025 + manual series; near-real-time at source)
sources.license: GODL-India (source: NWIC / Central Water Commission / CGWB, Ministry of Jal Shakti)
sources.attribution: Source: National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC) / CWC / CGWB, Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India — republished under GODL-India; curated for AIAIC.

sources.source_name: Central Ground Water Board — Dynamic Ground Water Resources of Madhya Pradesh (district categories)
sources.access_method: Local curated CSV extracted from CGWB 'Dynamic Ground Water Resources of Madhya Pradesh - 2024' report PDF (Annexure IV, DISTRICT TOTAL rows) via mp-groundwater-prep/extract_cgwb_mp.py
sources.license: GODL-India (source: CGWB / Ministry of Jal Shakti)
sources.attribution: Source: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India — Dynamic Ground Water Resources of Madhya Pradesh 2024.

isro_satellite_holdings._honesty: Real ISRO satellite data, authority Bhuvan / NRSC. Processed offline into curated CSVs, clipped to a Maharashtra bounding box, labelled by AIAIC itself as 'REGIONAL CONTEXT, UNCALIBRATED'. Annual snapshots - NOT a live feed, and therefore unable to produce a dynamic runtime observation.
